title: Central DNS Template
subtitle: This template is applied when a new domain is created and when "Apply Default Template" is clicked. Your changes take effect immediately.
saved: Template saved. New domains and "Apply Default Template" will use it.
empty_rows: No records in the template — start with "Add Record".
dkim_help: When DKIM is on, the template must contain a TXT record with {DKIM} (e.g. name: {SELECTOR}._domainkey). A 2048-bit RSA key pair is auto-generated per domain; the public key is written to DNS, and the private key is wired to the mail server if OpenDKIM is installed.
